column1: # label_fit rules for sysmes.bin short labels (2026-10-15): jp<TAB>en
# Rule: a one-line label of <= 16 Japanese bytes is drawn in a slot the Japanese layout sized -
# the button bar places the next icon at the Japanese label's width [confirmed in game, build 12:
# "Spirit Commands" (15 cells) over 精神コマンド (12) ran into the next icon] - so the English may
# not be wider than the Japanese: display cells = bytes with the control tokens (＠n, %s) removed.
# Tokens of the Japanese (＠4, ＠6, %s) are kept in the English, count and order.
